svg.title: How the crew works
svg.desc: You ask for something. Mel the foreman turns it into a task graph: the Writer writes copy, the Designer does layout, Dev builds, QA runs checks and sends fixes back. All workers take turns on one local model.
svg.text: A landing page for my bakery,
with a menu and a contact form
ONE LOCAL MODEL, WORKERS TAKE TURNS
speed shown live in tokens per second
